limitations: C31 vs C35 experiment codes cannot be decoded to strain/genotype/bait from PRIDE, the paper or deposited files (paper mentions Bdp1 IP-MS in WT vs cdk1-as1 but gives no run mapping); no factor value or genotype column added. The community-deposited SDRF was deliberately not consulted.
Organism part and cell type set to not available; disease not applicable. Yeast strain (S288c-derived, RDKY3615 or BY4741) not assignable per sample.
Reduction (DTT mentioned in PRIDE protocol) and alkylation reagents left not available: no alkylation stated and no Carbamidomethyl searched; DTT accession not verified.
Biological replicate numbers 1-3 follow the B1-B3 suffix in experiment names; paper does not confirm they are independent cultures.
